description: This file implements a deprecated audio filter class 'NoisereduceFilter' that uses the 'noisereduce' library to perform noise reduction on audio streams. It includes methods for starting, stopping, processing control frames, and filtering audio data, with external dependencies on 'numpy', 'loguru', and project-specific modules.

classes.name: NoisereduceFilter
classes.description: A deprecated audio filter class that applies noise reduction using the 'noisereduce' library.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the filter, sets default filtering state and sample rate, and issues a deprecation warning.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Sets the sample rate for the filter.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Placeholder for cleanup when stopping the filter.

methods.name: process_frame
methods.description: Enables or disables filtering based on control frames.

methods.name: filter
methods.description: Performs noise reduction on input audio bytes using spectral gating.
